40% of shipped tonnage stays in the state that made it, 57% crosses a line, 3% leaves the country. Axes are interstate only: California's 332k out excludes the 428k it handles at home.
The landfill recipe found no spillover to sites within 40 km of a closure, against a 55% effect a full redistribution would have made. Entirely different geography.
230,993 shipment records in 2023, all twelve management categories. In-state movement is counted as staying; only the destination state is known, not the distance.
